					<div class="entry-content">
					<div class="et-l et-l--post">
			<div class="et_builder_inner_content et_pb_gutters2"><div id="kitesurf" class="et_pb_section et_pb_section_0 et_section_regular" >
				<div id="next" class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_0 et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_0  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_0  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><strong>KITESURFING</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>We have everything you&#8217;ll need.</strong></h3>
<p>Are you looking for a fun and uplifting kitesurfing group lesson, private sessions, or simply want to hire equipment from a range of top brands? We&#8217;ve got you covered right here.</p>
<p>Discover this magical and idyllic location, and immerse yourself in a unique lifestyle filled with incredible adventures both on and off the water.</p>
<p>For those new to Langebaan, unsure about the conditions, or solo kite surfers, we offer the “Rent Your Kite-Buddy” experience. Share the excitement with our young, experienced local kiters. Enjoy accompanied kiting, with our friendly locals providing valuable tips, local insights, and support on and off the water.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_divider et_pb_divider_0 et_pb_divider_position_center et_pb_space"><div class="et_pb_divider_internal"></div></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_1  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_image et_pb_image_0">
				<span class="et_pb_image_wrap "><img fetchpriority="high" decoding="async" width="2560" height="1703" src="https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Kitesurfinglesson-scaled.jpg" alt="Kitesurfing lesson" title="Kitesurfing lesson" srcset="https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Kitesurfinglesson-scaled.jpg 2560w, https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Kitesurfinglesson-1280x852.jpg 1280w, https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Kitesurfinglesson-980x652.jpg 980w, https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2024/06/Kitesurfinglesson-480x319.jpg 480w" sizes="(min-width: 0px) and (max-width: 480px) 480px, (min-width: 481px) and (max-width: 980px) 980px, (min-width: 981px) and (max-width: 1280px) 1280px, (min-width: 1281px) 2560px, 100vw" class="wp-image-13737" /></span>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_2  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_0_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_0 et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="https://wa.me/27607794535" target="_blank" data-icon="">Book with us </a>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_3  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_1_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_1 et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="mailto:kite@capesport.co.za" target="_blank" data-icon="">Book with us </a>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_2 et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_4_4 et_pb_column_4  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_1  et_pb_text_align_center et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2><strong>KITESURFING</strong></h2>
<h3><strong>Kitesurf Lesson Rates</strong></h3>
<p>We offer <strong>rentals, classes and packages </strong>for everyone.<strong> Expand </strong>the packages below for all the detail:</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_button_module_wrapper et_pb_button_2_wrapper et_pb_button_alignment_center et_pb_button_alignment_tablet_left et_pb_button_alignment_phone_center et_pb_module ">
				<a class="et_pb_button et_pb_button_2 et_pb_bg_layout_light" href="https://capesports.co.za/wp-content/uploads/2025/11/kitesurfing_rental-prices-2025_2026.pdf" target="_blank" data-icon="5">View Rental Pricelist</a>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_3 et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters2">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_5  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_2  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Group sessions</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_0 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">8 hrs Beginner group package | R 700 pp /hr (2 days) R 5 600</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong>2 to 3 people in group (groups are not mixed and matched)</strong></p>
<p><strong style="font-size: 15px;">Course Content Beginners Basic:</strong></p>
<p>Safety theory (spot- and condition-check), first piloting of training kite, getting to know the &#8220;wind window&#8221;, learning how to set up your kite &amp; make use of safety-systems, first piloting (one- &amp; both-handed), launching and landing, kite recovery (water-relaunch) understanding depower systems, first body dragging, self-rescue</p>
<p><strong>Course Content Basic +</strong>:<br />Spot &amp; condition check, more independent set up of kite, enter &amp; exit of water independently, upwind &amp; downwind body dragging, board recovery.</p>
<p><b>Independency:</b></p>
<p>Learning how to get onto your board safely, positioning, first water start, starting both directions, coming to a controlled stop, first few meters of riding, controlling riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>*** depending on your level of progressing, these points might vary. Some people progress faster or slower in different sections. Our instructors will make sure, you are progressing in your own pace taking into count your own safety.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_6  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_3  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Private sessions</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_1 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">6 hrs Beginner private package | R 1 100.00 pp /hr (2 days 3 hrs per day) R 6 600</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong style="font-size: 15px;">Course Content Beginners Basic:</strong></p>
<p>Safety theory (spot- and condition-check), first piloting of training kite, getting to know the &#8220;wind window&#8221;, learning how to set up your kite &amp; make use of safety-systems, first piloting (one- &amp; both-handed), launching and landing, kite recovery (water-relaunch) understanding depower systems, first body dragging, self-rescue</p>
<p><strong>Course Content Basic +</strong>:<br />Spot &amp; condition check, more independent set up of kite, enter &amp; exit of water independently, upwind &amp; downwind body dragging, board recovery.</p>
<p><b>Independency:</b></p>
<p>Learning how to get onto your board safely, positioning, first water start, starting both directions, coming to a controlled stop, first few meters of riding, controlling riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>*** depending on your level of progressing, these points might vary. Some people progress faster or slower in different sections. Our instructors will make sure, you are progressing in your own pace taking into count your own safety.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_2 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">9 hrs Beginner private package | R 1 100.00 pp /hr (3 days 3 hrs per day) R 9 900</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong style="font-size: 15px;">Course Content Beginners Basic:</strong></p>
<p>Safety theory (spot- and condition-check), first piloting of training kite, getting to know the &#8220;wind window&#8221;, learning how to set up your kite &amp; make use of safety-systems, first piloting (one- &amp; both-handed), launching and landing, kite recovery (water-relaunch) understanding depower systems, first body dragging, self-rescue</p>
<p><strong>Course Content Basic +</strong>:<br />Spot &amp; condition check, more independent set up of kite, enter &amp; exit of water independently, upwind &amp; downwind body dragging, board recovery.</p>
<p><b>Independency:</b></p>
<p>Learning how to get onto your board safely, positioning, first water start, starting both directions, coming to a controlled stop, first few meters of riding, controlling riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>*** depending on your level of progressing, these points might vary. Some people progress faster or slower in different sections. Our instructors will make sure, you are progressing in your own pace taking into count your own safety.</p></div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_3 et_pb_column_7  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough et-last-child">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_4  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h2>Once off/Single sessions</h2></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_3 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">ONCE OFF | 2 hrs Progression Private Lesson 1:1 | R 1 250.00 pp /hr R 2 500</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><b>Advanced Mastery </b></p>
<p>Learning how to control riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>Upwind riding, seamless transitions, jumping techniques, toe-side riding, and mastering jibes.<br />Our instructors adjust the course based on your progression and safety needs.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_4 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">ONCE OFF | 3 hrs Private Lesson 1:1 | R 1 100.00 pp /hr R 3 300</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><b>Advanced Mastery </b></p>
<p>Learning how to control riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>Upwind riding, seamless transitions, jumping techniques, toe-side riding, and mastering jibes.<br />Our instructors adjust the course based on your progression and safety needs.</p></div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_module et_pb_toggle et_pb_toggle_5 et_pb_toggle_item  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_toggle_close">
				<h5 class="et_pb_toggle_title">ONCE OFF | 4 hrs group lesson 2:1 | R 700.00 pp / hr R 2 800</h5>
				<div class="et_pb_toggle_content clearfix"><p><strong style="font-size: 15px;">Course Content Beginners Basic:</strong></p>
<p>Safety theory (spot- and condition-check), first piloting of training kite, getting to know the &#8220;wind window&#8221;, learning how to set up your kite &amp; make use of safety-systems, first piloting (one- &amp; both-handed), launching and landing, kite recovery (water-relaunch) understanding depower systems, first body dragging, self-rescue</p>
<p><strong>Course Content Basic +</strong>:<br />Spot &amp; condition check, more independent set up of kite, enter &amp; exit of water independently, upwind &amp; downwind body dragging, board recovery.</p>
<p><b>Independency </b></p>
<p>Learning how to get onto your board safely, positioning, first water start, starting both directions, coming to a controlled stop, first few meters of riding, controlling riding speed by edging, knowing the safe conditions for kiting, learning to choose the right equipment according to the wind, knowing the right of way rules.</p>
<p>*** depending on your level of progressing, these points might vary. Some people progress faster or slower in different sections. Our instructors will make sure, you are progressing in your own pace taking into count your own safety.</p></div>

<p>Safety theory (spot- and condition-check), first piloting of training kite, getting to know the &#8220;wind window&#8221;, learning how to set up your kite &amp; make use of safety-systems, first piloting (one- &amp; both-handed), launching and landing, kite recovery (water-relaunch) understanding depower systems, first body dragging, self-rescue</p>
